architectural_units.name: Client
architectural_units.description: The client is the component that formulates service requests.

architectural_units.name: Server
architectural_units.description: The server is the component that receives, processes, and returns responses.

architectural_units.name: View
architectural_units.description: The component that we call View, is formed by the HTML and SCSS files of each component that make up the application.

architectural_units.name: ViewModel
architectural_units.description: The ViewModel component groups the TS files of the components and the services they have associated.

architectural_units.name: Model
architectural_units.description: The Models are the TypeScript classes that define the data contract consumed by the view and the ViewModel.

architectural_units.name: Presentation Layer
architectural_units.description: The presentation layer receives requests and builds responses.

architectural_units.name: Business Logic Layer
architectural_units.description: The business logic layer applies the domain rules.

architectural_units.name: Data Access Layer
architectural_units.description: The data access layer interacts with the database.

architectural_units.name: Domain Layer
architectural_units.description: The domain layer defines the data model.

architectural_units.name: Contract Layer
architectural_units.description: A transversal contract layer that separates the internal model from the external representation of the API.

architectural_units.name: Leader Service
architectural_units.description: This microservice has as its main function the routing of all communications to the corresponding microservice within the system architecture.

architectural_units.name: Portal Service
architectural_units.description: The portal microservice has as its main function to offer a centralized interface for access to the different VWGS applications.

architectural_units.name: Access Control Service
architectural_units.description: The Access Control microservice has as its main objective the management of user authentication and their permissions within the application.

architectural_units.name: Communication Log Service
architectural_units.description: The Communication Log microservice has as its main purpose to record all communications that occur within the system.

architectural_units.name: Scheduler Service
architectural_units.description: This microservice has as its main function the planning and programming of processes within the system.

architectural_units.name: Angular
architectural_units.description: Angular is a web development framework created by Google, based on the programming language TypeScript.

architectural_units.name: Spring Boot
architectural_units.description: Spring Boot is a framework that simplifies the creation of Java applications based on Spring.

architectural_units.name: HTTP
architectural_units.description: The message exchange protocol used in this case is HTTP.

architectural_units.name: JSON
architectural_units.description: The data format used is JSON.

architectural_units.name: Amazon Web Services
architectural_units.description: The provider for this project is Amazon Web Services.
The client formulates service requests, and the server receives, processes, and returns responses.
The Leader microservice has as its function the routing of all communications to the corresponding microservice within the system architecture.
The View is formed by the HTML and SCSS files of each component that make up the application. [...] The ViewModel acts as an intermediary between the View and the Model.
The presentation layer receives requests and builds responses. [...] The business logic layer applies the domain rules. [...] The data access layer interacts with the database.
The services are responsible for orchestrating HTTP calls to the server.

patterns.name: Microservices
patterns.description: The application has an architecture based on microservices.

patterns.name: Client-Server
patterns.description: The application follows the Client-Server pattern which organizes the code into two differentiated components: the client and the server.

patterns.name: MVVM
patterns.description: Angular applies the MVVM (Model-View-ViewModel) pattern, since its architecture is based on components and services.

patterns.name: Layered Architecture
patterns.description: Spring Boot organizes the code following the layered pattern with which responsibilities are separated.
